name: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization
definition: Initializes a set of 3D Gaussians from COLMAP point cloud data (xyz, rgb) by creating learnable parameters for position, features, scaling, rotation, and opacity.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization establishes a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation from input data using structured geometric priors rather than random noise or learned prediction networks.
